title: AI-resistant Java programming final exam
summary: Students complete an onsite supervised final containing one quiz and three programming exercises. Concise briefs, PNG/GIF requirements, partial templates, TODOs, hidden tests, and plagiarism checks make direct ChatGPT use impractical and the invigilated setting prohibits it.

sources.title: Recommendations to Create Programming Exercises to Overcome ChatGPT
sources.evidence_quote: conducted onsite under supervision to prevent any form of academic dishonesty

assessment.summary: Complete quiz, object-oriented programming, GUI, and streams exercises under supervision.
student_actions: Complete supplied Java templates from textual and visual requirements.
Compile and submit code without real-time test feedback.

student_role.description: The exam was onsite and supervised to prevent ChatGPT and other academic dishonesty.

grading.method: Quiz 20%; OOP 18%; GUI 35%; streams 27%. Only compilation status was shown during the exam.
